business_summary: Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd. plans, develops, and operates content for smartphone and other multi devices. It offers Women's Diary, a health care app for women; and Inaseri Ichiba website for general consumers that sells fisheries products, fruits, and vegetables. The company also provides business support services, such as kitting support, traffic information, and sound solution services; and system development and operation services for enterprise customers to streamline their business operations, as well as advertising agent services. In addition, the company engages in the renewable power generation business. Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
